newsitem.title: UK: JKX Oil and Gas appoints managing director.
newsitem.headline: JKX Oil and Gas appoints managing director.

text.p: JKX Oil and Gas said on Monday it had appointed Robert McCracklin as managing director with immediate effect to allow David Robson to concentrate on the firm's future developments as chief executive officer.
Robson used to hold both posts, but said he decided six months ago to split his job as he felt "overstretched in all directions."

McCrackin, 52, used to be managing director at Ranger Oil (UK) Ltd. He will take over responsibility for the day to day management of JKX's current projects, which are concentrated in the Ukraine and Georgia.
Shares in JKX rose 11 pence to 117 pence in low volume, recovering within its trading range from the six pence fall on Friday, market makers said.
